claims: Artemis II is a 10-day crewed test flight orbiting the Moon.
Artemis II verifies NASA's deep-space systems.
The Artemis II crew consists of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II crew validates the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems.
The Artemis II crew conducts maneuvers.
The Artemis II crew captures high-resolution imagery of the lunar surface.
Artemis II marks the first human return to lunar space in over 50 years.
